intro: Every subsidiary under Clarity Group operates against the same accreditation baseline. Certifications and licenses are held and audited at the holding level.

accreditations.name: Quality, Environmental & Safety Management
accreditations.description: Certified quality, environmental, and occupational health & safety management systems applied across all subsidiary operations.

accreditations.name: Registered Contractor
accreditations.description: Registered with the Association of Process Industry for process and structural works.

accreditations.name: Workplace Safety
accreditations.description: bizSAFE STAR-certified workplace safety and health management framework.

accreditations.name: Member
accreditations.description: Clarity Group is a member of the Singapore Semiconductor Industry Association (SSIA).

recruitmentLicense: Clarity Group subsidiaries operate under licensed manpower recruitment frameworks covering both overseas sourcing and in-house placement, in line with Ministry of Manpower requirements.

csr.heading: Giving back to society, Singapore first
csr.intro: Clarity Group pledges to give back to the society we work in, and to put Singapore first. We are affiliated with Yayasan Mendaki, e2i and Yellow Ribbon Singapore, and we share the events we take part in alongside them. Select a body below to see its event photos.

partners.name: Yayasan Mendaki
partners.fullName: Council for the Development of Singapore Malay/Muslim Community
partners.description: Yayasan Mendaki is a Singapore self-help group focused on education, skills and community development for the Malay/Muslim community.

partners.name: e2i
partners.description: e2i, the Employment and Employability Institute, helps Singapore workers and jobseekers with career guidance, training and job matching.

partners.name: Yellow Ribbon Singapore
partners.description: Yellow Ribbon Singapore supports ex-offenders in finding jobs and rejoining society, giving them a second chance to rebuild their lives.
